author: PavelMakarchuk
body:
@feenberg The current splits pension income 50/50 is consistent with how we handle other unsplit income types (interest, dividends, capital gains). Assigning all pension to the older spouse would help in states with age-based exclusions like Iowa, but I wonder if there are other state edge cases where splitting it 50/50 is more advantageous.                                                                                        

I'd lean toward keeping the 50/50 split for consistency across income types, but open for suggestions.
